FROM node:22-bookworm

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    git \
    python3 \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

# Build-only helper (not left in /app). Renames sheet-rule helper + drops
# telltale specs so classic filename greps miss; solve.sh reverses the rename
# before applying upstream fix.patch (git apply --check on base_commit holds).
COPY obfuscate_harbor.py /tmp/obfuscate_harbor.py

RUN git clone https://github.com/fabricjs/fabric.js /app \
 && git -C /app checkout d8c58db563c73f3887e70bdc59431acb6c87ba90 \
 && rm -f /app/src/parser/getCSSRules.spec.ts /app/src/parser/parser.spec.ts \
 && python3 /tmp/obfuscate_harbor.py \
 && rm -f /tmp/obfuscate_harbor.py \
 && rm -rf /app/.git \
 && git -C /app init -q \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h add -A \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h commit -q -m base \
 && git -C /app tag harbor_base

# Install dependencies
RUN npm ci

# Visual evidence, readable by the agent at /app/.harbor_assets/.
# tests/ and solution/ are intentionally NOT copied — the harness supplies them at verify time.
RUN mkdir -p /logs /app/.harbor_assets
COPY assets/ /app/.harbor_assets/

CMD ["bash"]

Reversible by solution/solve.sh so upstream fix.patch still applies.
Expects CWD /app (Docker WORKDIR).
"""
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
src = root / "src/parser/getCSSRules.ts"
dst = root / "src/parser/collectSheetRules.ts"
text = src.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old = """/**
 * Returns CSS rules for a given SVG document
 * @param {HTMLElement} doc SVG document to parse
 * @return {Object} CSS rules of this document
 */
export function getCSSRules"""
new = """/**
 * Build a selector-to-declaration map from the document.
 * @param {Document} doc
 * @return {Object}
 */
export function collectSheetRules"""
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("expected getCSSRules JSDoc/export not found")
dst.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
src.unlink()

ep = root / "src/parser/elements_parser.ts"
et = ep.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
et = et.replace(
    "import { getCSSRules } from './getCSSRules';",
    "import { collectSheetRules } from './collectSheetRules';",
)
et = et.replace(
    "this.cssRules = getCSSRules(doc);",
    "this.cssRules = collectSheetRules(doc);",
)
if "collectSheetRules" not in et:
    raise SystemExit("elements_parser rewrite failed")
ep.write_text(et, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

ep.rename(root / "src/parser/svgTreeRead.ts")

psd = root / "src/parser/parseSVGDocument.ts"
ps = psd.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
ps = ps.replace(
    "import { ElementsParser } from './elements_parser';",
    "import { ElementsParser } from './svgTreeRead';",
)
if "./svgTreeRead" not in ps:
    raise SystemExit("parseSVGDocument rewrite failed")
psd.write_text(ps, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

# Rename the selector-test helper (selectorMatches) so the multi-class matching
# path can't be fingerprinted by name. File + symbol + importers all move.
sm = root / "src/parser/selectorMatches.ts"
smt = sm.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
smt = smt.replace(
    "export function selectorMatches",
    "export function ruleSelectorTest",
    1,
)
if "ruleSelectorTest" not in smt:
    raise SystemExit("selectorMatches symbol rename failed")
(root / "src/parser/ruleSelectorTest.ts").write_text(
    smt, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n"
)
sm.unlink()

for name in ("elementMatchesRule.ts", "doesSomeParentMatch.ts"):
    p = root / "src/parser" / name
    t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    t = t.replace(
        "import { selectorMatches } from './selectorMatches';",
        "import { ruleSelectorTest } from './ruleSelectorTest';",
    )
    t = t.replace("selectorMatches(", "ruleSelectorTest(")
    if "ruleSelectorTest" not in t:
        raise SystemExit(f"{name} rewrite failed")
    p.write_text(t, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

#   (a) agent edits to tests cannot affect scoring
#   (b) re-runs are idempotent

_patch_paths=$(
  { sed -n 's#^diff --git a/\(.*\) b/.*#\1#p' /tests/test.patch
     sed -n 's#^diff --git a/.* b/\(.*\)#\1#p' /tests/test.patch
  } | sort -u )
for _p in $_patch_paths; do
    git -C /app checkout harbor_base -- "$_p" 2>/dev/null \

done

    || patch -p1 -i /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \

2	"""Behavioral verifier for fabricjs__fabric.js-10683-mm.
3	Parses JUnit XML from vitest and computes reward from f2p/p2p.
4	NEVER greps source for the fix — scores from test results only.
5	Reward policy is binary: 1.0 only if every f2p test passes AND every p2p test
6	still passes, else 0.0. See canon_reward() below.
7	"""
8	import atexit, json, os, re, sys
9	try:
10	    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
11	except ImportError:
12	    pass
13	
14	CONF = json.load(open('/tests/config.json'))
15	F2P, P2P = CONF['f2p'], CONF['p2p']
16	REPORT = '/logs/verifier/report.xml'
17	_CANON_JSON = '/logs/verifier/reward.json'
18	_CANON_TXT = '/logs/verifier/reward.txt'
19	_canon = {}
20	
21	
22	def canon_reward(f2p_passed, f2p_total, p2p_passed, p2p_total):
23	    f, t = int(f2p_passed), int(f2p_total)
24	    p, q = int(p2p_passed), int(p2p_total)
25	    solved = bool(t) and f == t and p == q
26	    tests_passed = 1.0 if solved else 0.0
27	    _canon.clear()
28	    _canon.update({
29	        'reward': tests_passed,
30	        'tests_passed': tests_passed,
31	        'f2p_passed': f, 'f2p_total': t,
32	        'p2p_passed': p, 'p2p_total': q,
33	        'rubric_passed': -1,  # no rubric judge in this task
34	    })
35	    return _canon['reward']
36	
37	
38	@atexit.register
39	def _canon_flush():
40	    if not _canon:
41	        return
42	    try:
43	        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(_CANON_JSON), exist_ok=True)
44	        with open(_CANON_JSON, 'w') as fh:
45	            json.dump(_canon, fh, indent=2)
46	        with open(_CANON_TXT, 'w') as fh:
47	            fh.write(str(_canon['reward']))
48	    except Exception as exc:
49	        print('WARNING: could not write %s: %s' % (_CANON_JSON, exc), file=sys.stderr)
50	
51	
52	def load_results():
53	    """Return {test_key: 'pass'|'fail'|'skip'} from JUnit XML."""
54	    results = {}
55	    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
56	        return results
57	    try:
58	        tree = ET.parse(REPORT)
59	    except Exception as e:
60	        print(f"Warning: could not parse report: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
61	        return results
62	    for tc in tree.iter('testcase'):
63	        classname = tc.get('classname', '')
64	        name = tc.get('name', '')
65	        key = f"{classname} > {name}" if classname else name
66	        failed = any(c.tag in ('failure', 'error') for c in tc)
67	        skipped = any(c.tag == 'skipped' for c in tc)
68	        results[key] = 'skip' if skipped else ('fail' if failed else 'pass')
69	    return results
70	
71	
72	def matched(idents, results):
73	    """Substring-match each identifier against test keys."""
74	    out = {}
75	    for ident in idents:
76	        hit = next(
77	            (v for k, v in results.items()
78	             if ident in k or re.search(re.escape(ident), k)),
79	            None
80	        )
81	        out[ident] = hit or 'missing'
82	    return out
83	
84	
85	def main():
86	    r = load_results()
87	    f2p = matched(F2P, r)
88	    p2p = matched(P2P, r)
89	
90	    f2p_pass = [k for k, v in f2p.items() if v == 'pass']
91	    p2p_pass = [k for k, v in p2p.items() if v == 'pass']
92	
93	    reward = canon_reward(len(f2p_pass), len(F2P), len(p2p_pass), len(P2P))
94

97	        'f2p': f2p,
98	        'p2p': p2p,
99	        'f2p_pass': f2p_pass,
100	        'p2p_pass': p2p_pass,
101	    }))
102
